title: Indian Market News Brief — 15 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: New public share offerings and strong earnings from some industrial firms may support market confidence. At the same time, legal disputes over bank bonds and weak earnings from mining companies create doubts. Overall, mixed news across different sectors is likely to keep market movements balanced.

stories.headline: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
stories.summary:
Yes Bank has asked the Supreme Court to review an order passed on October 15.
That order supported a High Court decision stopping the bank from writing off Rs 8,415 crore of AT-1 bonds.
The High Court had ruled that the bank administrator lacked authority to cancel the bonds.
These bonds were cancelled during the financial emergency faced by the bank earlier.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Banks and financial companies may face pressure if courts force them to repay old bond money.

stories.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
stories.summary:
Mahanadi Coalfields has filed paper work for an initial share sale worth about Rs 9,500 crore.
Parent firm Coal India plans to sell 66.18 crore shares, representing a 10 percent stake in the unit.
The final execution of the sale depends on regulatory approvals and market conditions.

stories.headline: Tata Sons Listing: Noel Tata decodes why there should be no tinkering; what he said at Hindustan Times Leadership Summit
stories.summary:
Noel Tata spoke about rules around mandatory stock market listing for Tata Sons.
He stated that listing could shift the group focus to shareholder gains over community work.
He said Tata Trusts will engage with regulators to protect the current way of running the business.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Shares of Tata Group companies may see mixed reactions as uncertainty remains over listing rules.

stories.headline: Dividend king PSU stock: Down 23% in 6 months! Nuvama sees 42% upside; target price, rationale
stories.summary:
NMDC reported a 3 percent year-over-year drop in second quarter core profit to Rs 19.4 billion.
The reported earnings came in below market expectations.
The stock fell 1.76 percent to Rs 69.90 after the announcement.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Lower profit from major mining companies could push down metal and government-owned stocks.

stories.headline: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
stories.summary:
RHI Magnesita reported a 62 percent increase in second quarter profit to over Rs 62 crore.
Total income rose modestly to Rs 1,038.26 crore for the July to September period.
Total company expenses fell to Rs 953.06 crore compared to the previous year.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Solid profit growth in manufacturing supply companies indicates healthy business activity.
